<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Risen Ghosts are generally only killed for the Ultimate Slayer title. Otherwise, the XP and GP/hr are mediocre at best.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="stats"><nowiki>Stats</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> level: 85</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per kill: 1000</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal kills per hour: 800 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 720 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per hour: 800k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 720k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Greater_Sonic_Wave_ability_codex <nowiki>Greater Sonic Wave ability codex</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1095411830207299654.png?v=1" alt="gsoniccodex" title="gsoniccodex" kind="icon" /></p>

</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="location-and-positioning"><ins><nowiki>Location and Positioning</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Risen Ghosts can be found in the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Crypt_(Wilderness) <nowiki>Crypt</nowiki>]<nowiki> North of Fort Forinthry after the question </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Unwelcome_Guests <nowiki>Unwelcome Guests</nowiki>]<nowiki> is complete.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>For both methods, place an </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1" alt="oldakcoil" title="oldakcoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> in the tile shown and stand underneath it.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/MIlLxZRIhW.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1" alt="torment" title="torment" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1" alt="affliction" title="affliction" kind="icon" /></p>

</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1" alt="elderovl" title="elderovl" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1" alt="weppoison" title="weppoison" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are active</nowiki></p>
